summary: Iteration 9 — validated the four new features end-to-end. Backend: real extraction on /tmp/duferco.pdf returns EXACTLY the expected 5-key extracted dict (fornitore 'Duferco Energia SpA', intestatario 'VERBA GROUP SRLS', tipo 'azienda', codice_fiscale/partita_iva '04137230928'), extraction_meta.method='pdf-text' verified=true, analysis=null, no consumi/prezzo/totale keys. New extraction._verify unit tests (9/9) cover verbatim-only whitelist, hallucinated fornitore/CF -> None, malformed codes -> None, tipo inference azienda for 11-digit CF and persona for 16-char CF, vision path skips presence check; extraction.pdf_text('/tmp/duferco.pdf') contains 'Duferco Energia SpA'. PUT /api/bills/{id}/confirm: 200; extra old fields totale/prezzo/periodo_fatturazione are SILENTLY IGNORED (not 422) because ExtractedData uses Pydantic default extras=ignore; extraction_meta.confirmed_by_user=true. Contact request: 422 for missing recapito/invalid email 'abc'/invalid phone '12ab'/consent=false; valid payload -> 200 with contact_request {email lowercased, phone normalised '+393331234567', consent_at, status 'da_contattare'}; notification 'Richiesta di contatto inviata' created; server log line 'Contact request email sent ... for bill_...'; other user -> 404. News: GET /api/news requires auth (401), returns 25 items sorted desc, each with title/link(http)/source(one of 5 feed names)/published_at/summary/category in {luce,gas,mercato,energia}; has_more+next_before pagination works with zero overlap and page-2 items strictly older; last_refresh and next_refresh (=last_refresh+3 days) present; sources length 5 matches feeds. POST /api/admin/news/refresh: admin -> 200 {refreshed:true,added>=0,errors:[]}; customer -> 403. news.refresh_news(db) right after a force refresh returns {refreshed:false, next_refresh}. No duplicate links in `news` collection. Regression: full pytest suite 99 passed + 1 skipped (SKIP_REAL_EMAIL — that one test also verified separately, PASSED). Old backend_test.py TestFlow assertions updated to match new behaviour (analysis is None, extracted has only the 5 keys, extraction_meta.confirmed_by_user checked, old totale field is dropped). FRONTEND (web 390x844, mario@test.it/Test1234): welcome-bolt renders EXACTLY 2 children (bolty-bolt-open.png base + bolty-bolt.png wink overlay), auto-transitions to Home. Home shows home-news card with the latest ANSA headline 'Carburanti, la mossa di Eni...'. /news screen: header 'News', news-meta 'Notizie reali da QualEnergia.it, Canale Energia, Rinnovabili.it, ANSA Economia, Il Sole 24 Ore. Ultimo aggiornamento: Oggi, 20:18 · si aggiorna ogni 3 giorni.', 25 news-item cards each with category chip, date, title, 'Fonte: '. Bill /bill/bill_e5b980504eaf: header subtitle 'Duferco Energia SpA', 4 Dati estratti rows with expected values, contact-sent card 'Richiesta di contatto inviata' with recapiti; NO 'La tua situazione'/'Spesa attuale'/'Possibile risparmio'/'€/mese' strings anywhere. Bill /bill/bill_e0ca9e4e163a (Enel): 'Non rilevato' fallback in 4 rows, contact-request card visible; contact-submit disabled (aria-disabled=true) until contact-consent ticked; invalid email 'abc' -> toast 'Indirizzo email non valido'. 'Correggi' modal shows exactly 4 fields (edit-fornitore/edit-intestatario/edit-codice_fiscale/edit-partita_iva); edit-totale/edit-consumo/edit-prezzo absent. Bollette list renders without '€/mese' and without 'Spesa attuale'. Admin (admin@bolty.it/Bolty!Admin2026): /admin/bill/bill_e5b980504eaf shows 5 data rows (Fornitore/Intestatario/Tipo/CF/P.IVA) with correct values, admin-contact-request card 'Il cliente chiede di essere ricontattato' with cliente@esempio.it and +393331234567 and consent date; Enel bill shows 4 'Non rilevato' fallbacks. Real-side effects during this iteration: 1 real /api/upload for duferco.pdf (LLM cost + admin email), 1 real contact-request email for the Enel Non rilevato bill via unit test (log line captured). Total real admin emails triggered: ~5 (1 duferco upload + 3 image-vision fallbacks from customer_bill fixtures across the full suite + 1 contact-request test).

minor.issue: Old fields totale/prezzo/periodo_fatturazione are SILENTLY IGNORED (dropped by Pydantic) rather than rejected with 422. The review request asked to report which behaviour ships — ignoring is what ships. If strict rejection is preferred, set `model_config = ConfigDict(extra='forbid')` on ExtractedData.

action_items: Decision only: keep confirm endpoint permissive (extras ignored, current behaviour) OR set ExtractedData.model_config extra='forbid' to return 422 on legacy keys — the review request left the choice to the implementer.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/extraction.py:_verify — verbatim presence check is the core guarantee; unit tests cover happy path, hallucinated values (name + CF), malformed codes, tipo inference (azienda for 11-digit CF, persona for 16-char CF), and vision-path bypass. Verified against real /tmp/duferco.pdf where pdf-text path is used and every returned value is present verbatim in the document text.

backend/news.py — feeds list == 5 names; refresh_news uses upsert on link (dedup); state.last_refresh drives 3-day gate and next_refresh output; list_news pagination uses `published_at $lt before` with an over-fetch of +1 to compute has_more/next_before. All verified via HTTP and direct DB checks.

backend/server.py:836-852 confirm_bill strips whitespace/empty strings to None and only persists the 5 allowed keys because Pydantic model_dump on ExtractedData is used before writing — confirmed by test that sends totale/prezzo and reads back only the 5 keys.

backend/server.py:859-908 bill_contact_request validation order is correct: bill ownership -> consent -> at least one recapito -> email regex -> phone regex. Phone normalisation strips whitespace/parentheses/dashes; email lowercased. Admin email includes CF/P.IVA/Fornitore rows plus a signed file link. Notification is inserted after the email attempt (email failure would still log 'FAILED' but not raise, so notification is always created).

backend/server.py:1274-1283 & 1336 news endpoints require auth and admin refresh is admin-gated; refresh_loop is scheduled from the startup event with a 6h check cadence and 3-day gate — consistent with news.CHECK_EVERY_SECONDS and REFRESH_EVERY.

rca_of_issue: No bugs. One design choice to confirm with main agent: /api/bills/{id}/confirm ignores legacy fields silently. This is often preferred for backward compatibility with old clients, but the review request explicitly asked to report the choice — ignoring (current) vs rejecting (would require extra='forbid'). Recommend keeping ignore behaviour.
